name: peeper
description: Tiny no-credit watcher for public X posts.

scripts.edge:once: mkdir -p state logs && node peeper.mjs --source fx --handle EdgeWallet --once --state state/edgewallet-seen.json --cache state/edgewallet-cache.json --on-new 'node scripts/like-with-xurl.mjs {id}'
scripts.edge:watch: mkdir -p state logs && node peeper.mjs --source fx --handle EdgeWallet --watch --interval 61 --state state/edgewallet-seen.json --cache state/edgewallet-cache.json --on-new 'node scripts/like-with-xurl.mjs {id}'
scripts.smoke: tmp_cache="$(mktemp)"; cp fixtures/edgewallet-cache.json "$tmp_cache" && node peeper.mjs --limit 1 --json --cache "$tmp_cache" | node -e "let s=''; process.stdin.on('data', d => s += d); process.stdin.on('end', () => { const j = JSON.parse(s); if (j.authUsed || j.xApiUsed || j.xAiUsed) throw new Error('paid/auth path used'); if (!j.tweets[0]?.id) throw new Error('missing tweet'); console.log(j.stale ? 'PASS cache' : 'PASS live', j.tweets[0].id); })"; status=$?; rm -f "$tmp_cache"; exit "$status"
